salaryTableImport.title: Load salary table
salaryTableImport.description: Review the source, version, effective period and every table row before saving a draft.
salaryTableImport.sourceFileHelp: The source file stays in this browser; its contents are not sent. Its SHA-256 is calculated automatically.
salaryTableImport.sourceSha256Help: The hash is calculated from the selected source file.
salaryTableImport.sourceFileInvalid: Choose a valid PDF or XLSX file no larger than 25 MB.
salaryTableImport.csvFileHelp: The CSV is read only in this browser. All parsed salary rows are shown for review.
salaryTableImport.csvFileInvalid: Choose a valid CSV file no larger than 900 KB.
salaryTableImport.csvHelp: Required columns: scale_code, scale_name, step_code, step_name, step_order, amount. Optional: hourly_amount, scale_order, step_kind, months_to_next_step, progression_type.
salaryTableImport.previewRequired: Review the full table and confirm the displayed values match the attached source.
salaryTableImport.sourceRuleNotice: Percentage source rules are recorded separately. Published source amounts remain unchanged; derived comparison amounts are not assigned automatically.

salaryTableImport.sourceReferenceNotice: Saving creates an audited draft revision with the source URL, source version and SHA-256. The source remains reference-only until independent validation is recorded. Publishing remains a separate step.
salaryTableImport.referenceOnly: Source recorded; independent validation is missing
salaryTableImport.correctionNotice: A published revision already exists with this effective date:
salaryTableImport.correctionConfirmation: Save this as a correction to that revision. The existing revision and historical payroll references will be preserved.
salaryTableImport.validationErrors: Review the input and correct the reported issues.
salaryTableImport.sourceInvalid: Check the title, version, HTTPS source URL, source file and source hash.
salaryTableImport.effectivePeriodInvalid: The effective start and end dates do not form a valid period.
salaryTableImport.csvInvalid: Check the CSV format, column names and complete table.
salaryTableImport.rowInvalid: Check the scale and step codes, amounts, order and progression values.
salaryTableImport.tableInvalid: One or more values do not satisfy the salary table rules.
salaryTableImport.readbackPending: The saved revision is being read back from Core.
salaryTableImport.readbackConfirmed: Core readback confirmed; all source rows match.
salaryTableImport.readbackFailed: The saved table differs from the input. Publishing remains closed.
salaryTableImport.existingDraft: A draft revision already exists for this structure. Complete it through the regular editing and publishing steps first.
